views.raw: RAW metric values as chapter4_qolu/env/evaluation.py defines them; distances are normalised by the grid diagonal.
views.absolute: absolute-normalised: the same metrics with RewardConfig.max_distance set to a physical distance, so proximity saturates at a fixed number of kilometres instead of at the grid diagonal.
views.minmax: cross-method min-max within one configuration x scenario x metric cell (worst method 0, best method 1), rescaled from the RAW view; the transparent analogue of the published tables' 'normalized between 0 and 1'.
